program = '''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in g:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    zeros = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == 0]
    zr0, zr1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    zc0, zc1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)
    source = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (background, 0)]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in source), max(r for r, c in source)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in source), max(c for r, c in source)
    pattern = [g[r][sc0:sc1 + 1] for r in range(sr0, sr1 + 1)]
    for i in range(zr1 - zr0 + 1):
        for j in range(zc1 - zc0 + 1):
            g[zr0 + i][zc0 + j] = pattern[i][len(pattern[0]) - 1 - j]
    return g
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
